descriptions.value: A CoE SDO request for index 0xFFFF matches the object list terminator entry instead of returning not-found. The terminator has a NULL objdesc pointer. Callers dereference it without checking, crashing the slave.

assertions.title: CoE OD Sentinel NULL Pointer Dereference

title: CoE OD Sentinel NULL Pointer Dereference
